lines.en: label sanadorm5:
I knock on the door and wait a moment to see if anyone responds.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门，等了片刻，看有没有人应声。

lines.en: Well, to see if Sana responds.
lines.zh: 好吧，是看 Sana 会不会应声。

lines.en: If anyone other than her or Ayane answered, I'd probably just leave.
lines.zh: 要是开门的不是她或 Ayane，我大概扭头就走。

lines.en: Either way, no one does- but I’m suddenly compelled to knock again for reasons beyond my comprehension.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，没人应——可我忽然又莫名地想再敲一次，理由连我自己都解释不清。

lines.en: : Hello? Is anyone in there?
lines.zh: : 你好？有人在吗？

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : Yup. Just dropping by to see how you're doing.
lines.zh: : 嗯。顺路过来看看你怎么样。

lines.en: : You're...
: Dropping by...my room?...
lines.zh: : 顺路……来我的房间？……

lines.en: I guess I'm going to have to speak to Sana through the door until I can convince her to allow me inside of her room.
lines.zh: 看来在说服她让我进去之前，我只能隔着门跟 Sana 说话了。

lines.en: : Is that weird?
lines.zh: : 这很奇怪吗？

lines.en: : I don't...think it's normal for...teachers to come to their students' rooms...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得老师跑到学生房间里……不太正常……

lines.en: : Well, I'm here. So I guess this just means either I leave or we hang out.
lines.zh: : 嗯，反正我都来了。所以接下来要么我走，要么我们待一会儿。

lines.en: : The choice is in your hands.
lines.zh: : 选择权在你手上。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I'll understand if you don't want to, Sana. It's fine.
lines.zh: : 你不想的话我也能理解，Sana。没关系。

lines.en: : I...I didn’t say that, but...
lines.zh: : 我……我又没那么说，不过……

lines.en: : If it makes you feel any better, I'm doing this for educational purposes.
lines.zh: : 要是这样能让你好受一点，我来这是出于教育目的。

lines.en: : What...sort of educational purposes...would that even-
lines.zh: : 什么样的……教育目的……会——

lines.en: : It's part of that new strategy I was talking about in class. The one where we need to start being friendlier and less formal.
lines.zh: : 这是我在课上说的那套新策略的一部分。就是我们要开始更友好、不那么拘礼的那套。

lines.en: : I don't know, Sensei...This still seems really weird...
lines.zh: : 我也不知道，Sensei……这还是感觉很奇怪……

lines.en: : I don't think so. It's just a totally normal and socially acceptable after-school self-invitation.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得。这只是一个完全正常、符合社交礼仪的放学后自我邀请。

lines.en: : So, can I come in?
lines.zh: : 那么，我能进来吗？

lines.en: : I'm...starting to think you won't go away even if I say no...
lines.zh: : 我……开始觉得就算我说不，你也不会走了……

lines.en: : That's a fair assumption.
lines.zh: : 这个推测挺合理的。

lines.en: I hear the sound of the door unlocking and take that as my cue to make my way inside.
lines.zh: 我听见门锁打开的声音，便把这当作进去的信号。

lines.en: scene black
scene smallredux1
: G...Good evening...
lines.zh: : 晚……晚上好……

lines.en: : Thanks for letting me in. I get that it probably feels a little weird.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你让我进来。我知道这大概让你觉得有点怪。

lines.en: : It's...more than just...a little...
lines.zh: : 不止……一点点……

lines.en: : But...um...here we are...
lines.zh: : 不过……嗯……我们到了……

lines.en: : The place I...live...
lines.zh: : 我……住的地方……

lines.en: : I’m going to go out on a limb here and assume your side is on the right?
lines.zh: : 我大胆猜一下，你那半边是右边？

lines.en: : Umm...yeah...If you’re looking at it...from your direction...
lines.zh: : 嗯……对……如果你……从你那个方向看的话……

lines.en: : If you...look at it from mine it’s...it's on the...left...
lines.zh: : 如果从……我的方向看，那就是……在……左边……

lines.en: : Thank you for explaining how directions work, Sana. I had forgotten.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你给我讲解方向是怎么回事，Sana。我都忘了。

lines.en: : You're...
lines.zh: : 不用……

lines.en: : You're welcome...
lines.zh: : 不用谢……

lines.en: This is even more awkward than I thought it would be.
lines.zh: 这比我预想的还要尴尬。

lines.en: : I'm going to go out on a second limb here and assume you’ve also never been alone with a guy before, have you?
lines.zh: : 我再大胆猜一下，你应该也从来没有跟男生独处过吧？

lines.en: : R-Right...
: But you’re just my teacher so...I don’t...really look at you that way...
lines.zh: : 可你只是我的老师，所以……我……没真的把你往那个角度看……

lines.en: : You don’t...view me as a male?
lines.zh: : 你……不把我当男性看？

lines.en: scene smallredux2
: Oh! N-No! That’s not what I meant! I obviously...know you're...uhh...It’s just that...umm...
lines.zh: : 哦！不——不是！我不是那个意思！我当然……知道你是……呃……只是……嗯……

lines.en: scene smallredux3
: Hah...
: This is just...kind of embarrassing for me, so...
lines.zh: : 我只是……觉得挺难为情的，所以……

lines.en: : I'm probably going to...say a lot of things that are...um..........bad.
lines.zh: : 我大概会……说很多……嗯……………不该说的话。

lines.en: : Noted.
lines.zh: : 记下了。

lines.en: Sana’s half of the dorm is more or less what I expected.
lines.zh: Sana 的这半间宿舍，跟我预想的差不多。

lines.en: The only thing I'd say is different from my imagination is the lack of black, but I guess all the spider stickers make up for that.
lines.zh: 唯一跟我想象中不同的是，黑色的东西少了一点，不过那些蜘蛛贴纸大概算是补上了。

lines.en: Apart from that, everything seems mostly normal.
lines.zh: 除此之外，一切看起来都挺正常。

lines.en: Bed? Check. Video game stuff? Check. Creepy stuffed animal facing the ceiling? Another check.
lines.zh: 床？有。游戏相关的东西？有。面朝天花板的诡异毛绒玩具？也有。

lines.en: Considering that only one of those three things is worth talking about, though, I pretty much know where to move the conversation next.
lines.zh: 不过这三样里只有一样值得聊，所以我基本知道接下来该往哪儿引了。

lines.en: : I didn’t know you were into games, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你还喜欢游戏，Sana。

lines.en: scene smallredux4
: Oh! Y...Yes!
lines.zh: : 哦！是……是的！

lines.en: : I don’t...really go out much, so...
lines.zh: : 我……不怎么出门，所以……

lines.en: : I sort of...play games to pass the time...
lines.zh: : 就有点像……靠打游戏打发时间……

lines.en: : Well, maybe we could play something together sometime? That might be a decent way to get to know each other.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那也许我们什么时候可以一起玩点什么？这可能是相互了解的一个不错的方式。

lines.en: scene smallredux5
: You...play games, Sensei? You don’t think you’re...too old for that?
lines.zh: : 你……也打游戏，Sensei？你不觉得自己……太老了吗？

lines.en: : There’s no such thing as being ‘too old’ for video games, Sana. That's a myth.
lines.zh: : 打电子游戏这回事可没有“太老”这一说，Sana。那是个谬论。

lines.en: : Also, don’t call me old.
lines.zh: : 还有，别说我老。

lines.en: : Oh, I...I didn't mean it like that...I’m sorry...
lines.zh: : 哦，我……我不是那个意思……对不起……

lines.en: : It’s just that...my mom is always telling me I should go out more, and...umm...experience the world, I think she said?...
lines.zh: : 只是……我妈妈总说我该多出去走走，还有……嗯……去体验世界，好像是这么说的？……

lines.en: : Which...isn't really possible since we can't leave Kumon-mi, so...
lines.zh: : 可……我们根本离不开 Kumon-mi，这也做不到，所以……

lines.en: : I think you should do whatever you like to do. Life quickly becomes miserable once you start worrying too much about other people.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你该做自己喜欢的事。人一旦开始太在意别人，日子很快就变得悲惨了。

lines.en: scene smallredux4
: Th-Thank you...Sensei...I...I completely agree...
lines.zh: : 谢……谢谢……Sensei……我……我完全同意……

lines.en: : If you want...maybe we...could play together sometime?...
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意……也许我们……什么时候可以一起玩？……

lines.en: : Sounds good to me. What sorts of games are you into, exactly?
lines.zh: : 我没问题。你到底喜欢什么样的游戏？

lines.en: : Mostly RPGs...and simulation games...
lines.zh: : 主要是 RPG……还有模拟经营……

lines.en: : I play...um...visual novels too, but...I...prefer playing those alone, so...
lines.zh: : 我也玩……嗯……视觉小说，不过……我……更喜欢一个人玩，所以……

lines.en: : Well, we can play whatever you choose. I can't remember the last time I played anything, though, so try not to beat me too badly.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你选什么我们就玩什么。不过我都记不清上次打游戏是什么时候了，所以别把我打得太惨。

lines.en: I conveniently leave out the detail where I can't remember anything else either.
lines.zh: 我很方便地略过了另一个细节：别的事我也什么都记不清了。

lines.en: : Heheh...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……

lines.en: : I...make no promises...
lines.zh: : 我……可不敢保证……

lines.en: scene black
Sana turns around and steps toward her bed, but I remain where I am since I can't imagine she's anything like her roommate in terms of her willingness to cozy up to an older man.
lines.zh: Sana 转过身朝自己的床走去，而我留在原地——我想象不出她会像她室友那样，愿意跟一个年长的男人挨得那么近。

lines.en: At least not yet. I have no idea how Sana will end up a little further down the line. But that line is so far away from the entrance to her dorm room that there's no point in even acknowledging it yet.
lines.zh: 至少现在还不会。我不知道再往后一点 Sana 会变成什么样。但那条线离她宿舍门的入口实在太远，现在根本不值得去想。

lines.en: scene sanaroom1
: This...isn't as scary as I thought it was going to be...
lines.zh: : 这……没有我想的那么可怕……

lines.en: : I'll admit that...I didn't really want to let you inside, but...
lines.zh: : 我承认……我其实挺不想让你进来的，不过……

lines.en: : You've been really nice so far, so...thank you...
lines.zh: : 到目前为止你都很好，所以……谢谢你……

lines.en: Sana begins to fiddle with a bow wrapped around the neck of an ugly stuffed animal- admitting things to it since admitting them to me would be much harder.
lines.zh: Sana 开始摆弄一只丑陋毛绒玩具脖子上系的蝴蝶结——她把这些话说给它听，因为说给我听要难得多。

lines.en: : There's no need to thank me. I'm sure I'll do plenty to upset or anger you in the future. It would just be rude to do that on my first trip here.
lines.zh: : 不用谢我。我以后肯定会做不少让你难过或者生气的事。第一次来就那样做就太失礼了。

lines.en: scene sanaroom2
: Well...thank you so far, then...
lines.zh: : 嗯……那就谢谢到目前为止的你……

lines.en: : It might not sound like it, but...
lines.zh: : 听着也许不像，不过……

lines.en: : I...do like talking to you, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我……确实喜欢跟你说话，Sensei……

lines.en: : Or...trying to, at least...
lines.zh: : 或者……至少是在试着说……

lines.en: : Don’t worry about the ‘trying’ part. Things will start coming out a lot more naturally in time.
lines.zh: : “试着”那部分别在意。再过些时候，一切自然就会顺畅很多。

lines.en: : Just treat me like a friend until you’re more comfortable and I’m sure everything will be fine.
lines.zh: : 在你更自在一些之前，就把我当朋友对待就好，我敢肯定一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: scene sanaroom3
: R...Right...Yeah...
: Like a friend...
lines.zh: : 像朋友一样……

lines.en: : I’m sorry...I’m just having...um...a hard time...thinking of you as anything more than my teacher right now, but...
lines.zh: : 对不起……我只是……嗯……现在还很难把你当成老师以外的什么，不过……

lines.en: : But I'm sure that...will change eventually...
lines.zh: : 不过我敢肯定……总有一天会变的……

lines.en: : Good. Because a little piece of my heart broke off earlier when you said you didn’t even think of me as a guy.
lines.zh: : 很好。因为刚才你说你根本没把我当成男人，我的一小块心都碎了。

lines.en: scene sanaroom4
: That!...Well!...
: I said...I'm sorry! I...don't know what else you want!
lines.zh: : 我都说了……对不起了！我……不知道你还想要我怎样！

lines.en: : All I want is to make you happy, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我只想让你开心，Sana。

lines.en: : Then...don't bring up the...weird things I say on accident!
lines.zh: : 那……就别再提我……不小心说出的那些怪话了！

lines.en: : Say less weird things and that won't be a problem.
lines.zh: : 少说点怪话就不成问题了。

lines.en: scene sanaroom5
: I'll try...
lines.zh: : 我会努力的……

lines.en: : And...umm...I’ll...try my best to make you...a little happy too...
lines.zh: : 还有……嗯……我也会……尽我所能让你……稍微开心一点的……

lines.en: : As your...umm...
lines.zh: : 作为你的……嗯……

lines.en: : As your...friend...
lines.zh: : 作为你的……朋友……

lines.en: scene black
Feeling like that's a good place to leave things for the night, I turn around and reach for the door, only to be stopped a split second later.
lines.zh: 觉得今晚到这里收尾正合适，我转过身去够门把手，却在半秒后被叫住了。

lines.en: scene smallredux5
: Huh?....Are you leaving already, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 咦？……你这就走了吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: : Yeah. I think we’ve made enough progress for the day.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我觉得今天已经进展够多了。

lines.en: : You helped me kill some time and I got to see your room. Those are two solid victories.
lines.zh: : 你帮我打发了点时间，我也参观了你的房间。这可是两场实打实的胜利。

lines.en: scene smallredux4
: Hahah...If you say so...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……你这么说也行……

lines.en: : Will you, umm...come back soon?...
lines.zh: : 你，嗯……会很快再来吗？……

lines.en: : I'd...like to maybe...do this again sometime...
lines.zh: : 我……也许……想什么时候再这样一次……

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : You can always come visit me too, you know. I'm normally in my office after school.
lines.zh: : 你也可以随时来找我。放学后我一般在办公室。

lines.en: : I’ll...try to remember that...
lines.zh: : 我……会尽量记住的……

lines.en: : Sounds good. I’ll see you later, Sana. Thanks for letting me in.
lines.zh: : 好。回头见，Sana。谢谢你让我进来。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: See you later...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 回头见……Sensei……

lines.en: scene black
I exit the room and start making my way back to the street.
lines.zh: 我走出房间，开始往街上走。

lines.en: I figured it would take Sana a little longer to let me inside, but I guess my initial read on her wasn't as accurate as I thought.
lines.zh: 我本以为要花更久才能让 Sana 放我进去，不过看来我对她的第一印象没那么准。

lines.en: Either way, I’m glad she’s finally starting to warm up to me.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我很高兴她终于开始对我放下戒心了。

lines.en: Here's hoping that doesn't stop anytime soon.
lines.zh: 希望这势头别那么快停下来。

lines.en: $ sana_love += 1
$ sanadorm5 = True
Sana’s affection has increased to [sana_love]! You can now spend time with her in her room!
lines.zh: Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]！你现在可以去她房间陪她了！
